title: 3 BOXES OF AVON GLASSWARE
reason: Large collection of Avon Cape Cod ruby glass, a collected pattern with sellable extras; the Avon claim is supported by pattern, not by marks. Heavy and fragile, and the pattern is common.
findings: Ruby red pressed glass in the Avon 1876 Cape Cod pattern (no maker's marks or Avon labels visible, which is normal for the pattern). Roughly 60 to 70 pieces: about 20 small bowls in stacks, about 25 plates (dinner and salad sizes), six footed mugs, two tall flared footed vases, and a large diamond-cut bowl holding about a dozen napkin rings. A paper ticket on the wall at the right is not part of the goods and is illegible. Same pattern as lot 468, so a buyer wanting a full service could use both lots. The pattern is common, so the value lies in the volume and the sellable extras (mugs, tall vases, napkin rings).
condition: No chips or cracks visible at photo resolution, but rim chips on stacked bowls and plates are hard to spot. Stacked without protection.
rescore_note: Cape Cod ruby pressed glass (Avon pattern, identified by pattern not marks), about 60-70 pieces including six mugs, two vases and napkin rings; common pattern, heavy and fragile so local pick-up buyers only, and unprotected stacks probably hide rim chips. Realistic bulk value in the $80-200 band, likely the lower half. (No fresh comps, search limit hit.)
